scope: Focused follow-up on exact 8015-P2 and AAT after delivery of seven new challenger screens. These are existing-leader updates and do not increase new-candidate counts.
decision: Retain both existing staged priorities; no S-tier promotion. New findings chiefly improve independent model choices and expose transfer/attribution errors to prevent.

updates.name: Exact 8015-P2 for MFN2-CMT2A
updates.decision: Continue human functional qualification; add an independent allele/model challenge and specify solvent controls.

findings.finding: A 2026 independent JCI Insight study provides isogenic MFN2 R94Q/+ hESC-derived motor neurons with exact clone identifiers. At days34–36, electrophysiological activity was present but overt WT-versus-mutant electrophysiological differences were absent, despite mitochondrial transport defects.
findings.denominator: One parental MShef11 hESC background with independently edited clones, not multiple donors. Patch-clamp total n33 cells. Transport treatment comparison n6 WT/n12 variant neurons from three differentiations, not eighteen people.
findings.consequence: This is a concrete mechanistic-screen route, not an already qualified human restored-function assay. An absent disease functional deficit must not be called drug failure or rescue.
findings.proposed_action: Qualify genotype-linked transmission/force or an appropriately mature network deficit before testing restoration; retain transport as a mechanistic readout.

findings.finding: In that model ACY-738 at100nM for24h partially improved mitochondrial trafficking. A second deacetylase inhibitor supported a tubulin-acetylation mechanism. Fish swimming benefit came from exposure beginning at8days postfertilization, with oral exposure later, rather than a clean delayed adult-onset intervention.
findings.consequence: ACY-738 is useful as a transport-positive control. It cannot supply exact-P2 evidence, established human functional rescue or independently replicated delayed-disease restoration.

findings.finding: The 2021 VanLent primary study includes a patient MFN2 R94Q line and isogenic correction. The mutant had elevated MEA burst rate; correction restored the network phenotype. Patient data involve one MFN2 background within a larger multi-CMT cohort.
findings.denominator: Burst-rate figure uses9–16 wells pooled from two differentiations; wells are nested observations. Genetic correction occurs before differentiation and is not drug reversal of an established network deficit.
findings.consequence: Useful human electrophysiological disease features can be qualified, but are protocol/background/endpoint dependent. Patch-clamp equivalence atd34 in another model does not contradict a separate network hyperactivity phenotype.
findings.proposed_action: Require stable, genetically reversible network or neuromuscular deficit. Track evoked performance and healthy-culture effects so sedation or cytotoxicity is not misclassified as normalization of burst rate.

findings.finding: CMTA's completed May2026 Manor project, updatedSeptember24, reports patient-derived neuronal models and an operating R364W rat model. CMTA's toolbox lists two CMT2A rat models and a CRO route for behavior, electrophysiology and peripheral-nerve PK. PsychoGenics publicly reports grip/gait/conduction characterization.
findings.consequence: An orthogonal allele challenge beyond the originating T105M group has a publicly documented operating route. This is model capability evidence, not exact-P2 efficacy, secured capacity, quoted price or unrestricted animal stock.
findings.rights: USPTO official gazette confirms US12,721,327B2 grantedSeptember1,2026. Claim1 describes R364W/H361Y knock-in rats with spatially/age-dependent peripheral axon/Schwann-cell degeneration. This is a model right, distinct from compound patents; the public service path includes access/licensing.

findings.finding: The2026rat methods describe250mg/mL P2 inDMSO diluted to a typical10mg/mL working solution in30%HP-beta-cyclodextrin. The listed vehicle is30%HP-beta-cyclodextrin without explicitly stating finalDMSO.
findings.calculation: 10/250=0.04: a4%v/v DMSO contribution under simple stock dilution. This is a calculation conditional on the reported concentrations, not proof of the control's composition or every dose cohort's recipe.
findings.consequence: The final-solvent match is unresolved in the text. Do not infer DMSO caused efficacy or that the authors omitted it in practice.
findings.proposed_action: Prespecify identical finalDMSO/HP-beta-cyclodextrin across active, P1, mixture and vehicle formulations and analytically verify concentration/purity.

findings.finding: A2026PNAS primary abstract reports AAV9-MFN2 and an ER-targeting MFN1 isoform, with post-symptom motor benefit in a transgenic CMT2A model. The paper's PMC record is embargoed untilDecember16,2026; complete construct/dose/denominator details were not retrieved in this pass.
findings.consequence: ER-mitochondria contact restoration is a relevant orthogonal comparator hypothesis. It is not exact-P2 evidence or a fully qualified new candidate from an abstract.

updates.go: Independent, exact-P2 restoration of a stable genetically attributable human functional deficit at qualified free exposure, with meaningful healthy-cell window and a second allele/background challenge.
updates.stop_or_narrow: Only transport improves; the chosen model has no functional deficit; healthy-network suppression creates an apparent normalization; mixture alone works; or a second allele fails, requiring a narrower indication.
updates.retrieval_limit: The public381.3KB primary-dataZIP was located, but web and direct download returned a challengeHTML page rather than binary data. No new animal-level recalculation is claimed.

updates.name: Qualified AAT during donor-lung perfusion
updates.decision: Retain small formulation/activity gate before further scarce-organ validation; no new exact-route transplant durability established.

findings.finding: CSL patent pig methods describe3mg/mL nominal AAT, but Example8 reports0.5mg/mL human AAT antigen throughout12h byELISA. The difference is unexplained in the inspected text. Sodium/chloride and late calcium concentrations also differed between groups.
findings.consequence: Nominal added mass, immunoreactive concentration and activeNE/PR3 inhibitory capacity must be separate quantities. The record does not justify assigning83%loss, a specific adsorption mechanism, or this recipe to the2026human study.
findings.proposed_action: Resolve antigen assay recovery/calibration, active-protein mass balance and final perfusate physicochemistry before using a nominal dose as a transferable exposure target.

findings.finding: An independent2021 murine allograft study used buffer-exchangedRespreeza/Prolastin, administered systemically to recipients before/after surgery. Histologic rejection improved atday3. About40%of experiments involved intraoperative death and were excluded; analyzedgroups were10AAT/5control.
findings.consequence: It adds independent short-term biological support, with preparation-specific confounding partly addressed by buffer exchange. It does not establish warm-EVLP product equivalence, graft gas-exchange durability, survival benefit or complete enrolled-animal outcomes.
findings.proposed_action: Keep route, exact preparation, attrition denominator and endpoint attached to the evidence. Do not count this as another controlled human EVLP replication.

findings.finding: A2025retrospectiveSRTR/pharmacy analysis included447lung recipients with AATdeficiency;109used augmentation before transplant and32continued afterward. Age-adjusted survival associations favored posttransplant augmentation, with differing baseline age and ischemic time and incomplete pharmacy capture.
findings.consequence: This is a nonrandomized systemic replacement/augmentation question in AATdeficient recipients. It cannot verify repair from a finite ex-vivo-only pulse in generally injured donor lungs.
findings.proposed_action: Retain as separate human biological context; do not pool its447recipients with eight paired human EVLP donors or describe the estimated association as a randomized causal effect.

updates.unchanged_critical_evidence: The eight-donor2026human EVLP abstract and likely corresponding2020conference report remain one probable underlying dataset. The2018cold-storage active/inactive-AAT/protease-knockout study remains the stronger causal protease evidence; this pass does not replace or duplicate that prior finding.
updates.go: QualifiedNE/PR3 activity and a persistent useful gas-transfer/compliance advantage versus physically matched control and a simplerNE-selective comparator under drug-free recipient-like reperfusion.
updates.stop: Physicochemical matching or the simpler comparator accounts for useful effect, no activity remains through the intended window, or benefit requires ongoing systemic recipient treatment outside the proposed product.
updates.retrieval_limit: The2026human full methods and2018pig survival-abstract dataset were not retrieved through accessible primary routes in this bounded pass. No dose/recipe/recipient outcome was imputed from their titles.
